original.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as a new optional datapath mode for Linux kernels 6.8 or newer, with veth remaining the default.

exposure.needed: whether the operator intends to switch an existing veth-based deployment to the netkit datapath mode (the evidence names no configuration key that selects netkit)

corrected.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as an opt-in datapath mode for Linux kernels 6.8 or newer, and veth remains the default. Only environments that plan to move an existing veth-based deployment to netkit are concerned, because that switch cannot be done in place. The evidence names no setting that would show this intent, so exposure cannot be decided from static inputs.

decision.reason: [ev-5ba316aaead4] says netkit is a new opt-in datapath mode, veth stays the default, and an existing veth setup cannot be switched to netkit in place. Kernel 6.8 or newer is only what netkit needs to run. Running such a kernel does not expose an environment to any change, so the proposed kernel >=6.8 condition is too broad. The only relevant environments are those that plan to switch an existing veth deployment to netkit. The evidence names no setting that shows this intent, so exposure cannot be written as a static predicate.
